name: SwitchingOrderBuilder
tagline: Write, check, approve and execute switching programmes – with sequence checks and a live earths & isolations register.
description: A complete switching-programme app for electricity network control rooms on the Power Platform. Planners write programmes from templates (feeder bay, pole transformer / line section, load transfer); the app checks the step order (earth without prove dead, closing onto an earth, operating during a safety document, earths left on); an independent checker and a control engineer approve it; the control room then executes it step by step with instruct / confirm / fail / skip and a time-stamped log, while the earths & isolations register shows what is applied on the network. Decision aid – validate every programme against your switching and safety rules.
features: Step templates for feeder bays, pole transformers and load transfers
Strict execution order with time-order validation
Live earths, safety documents, isolation points and notices register
Bulk operator assignment, undo, CSV export
Power Fx outputs and six events
Demo mode with a fictional control room
Phone layout with large touch targets
